output.reason: [ev-dcd7685c65da] limits this guidance to installs where Helm installs the CRDs, "installCRDs=true - the default". Argo CD or Flux setups that manage CRDs directly with Helm are covered too, because they use the same value. So the right exposure is installCRDs explicitly true or unset, since unset falls back to the default of true, and the proposed any[] condition says exactly that. The guidance names no other environment state, so the condition is neither broader nor narrower than the evidence.
